# Citi, Cross River lead inKind USD 414 million financing tranche
PUBT _·_ 3d ago
Citi, Cross River lead inKind USD 414 million financing tranche
* inKind raised USD 414 million in an oversubscribed second financing tranche led by Citi, with Cross River providing USD 150 million of senior financing.
* inKind runs a restaurant commerce platform that provides upfront growth capital, demand generation, rewards, financial tools, proprietary data, and AI-driven capabilities.
* The financing lifted inKind’s total capital raised to more than USD 1.2 billion.
* inKind said its network links more than 5 million diners with more than 8,500 restaurants, representing nearly USD 30 billion in annual restaurant GMV.
